services.name: 1/2 Day Guided Fishing Charter
services.desc: Fishing with Captain Matt, a NYSDEC licensed and insured fishing guide! Duration 4.5 Hours About Bring your family and friends along to explore the less traveled areas of the river. Captain Matt, can bring you out in both Canadian and U.S. waters in pursuit of Northern Pike, Walleye, Smallmouth Bass, and Yellow Perch. All bait and tackle will be provided. Customers 18 years of age and older are strongly encouraged to obtain a 1-day Canadian fishing license. In addition, guests 16 and older must obtain a New York State fishing license before departure. You can easily purchase Canadian day licenses on your phone through [Ontario Fish and Wildlife](https://www.huntandfishontario.com/). NYS

Land & Sea Eco-Tour
services.desc: Family-friendly cruise option! Duration 2.5 Hours About Bring your friends and family and join us aboard “Goose,” our 23′ boat for a one of a kind vacation experience on the St. Lawrence River. 1000 Islands Excursions eco-tours are suitable for all ages as Capt. Matt will tailor the eco-tour to your unique interests. This is a great family friendly vacation activity that will create memories for years to come! During your private boat tour, we may spot a variety of birds and small mammals. services.name: Yacht Rock Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Fun for friends and family! Duration 1.5 Hours About This relaxing 90 minute tour departs Dockside Cottages and will offer views of the Canadian and U.S. Islands. As we head into the sunset, we will be listening to the relaxing vibes of Yacht Rock Radio as we take in the spectacular views and hues, only found in the 1000 islands. AND - if you really don’t like Yacht Rock, we are open to alternatives! More Info Children 2 years of age and under are free. What to Bring Don't forget to bring along your personal cooler and favorite drinks to make the most of this relaxing journey. “Goose” will have plastic reusable cups, a wine and bottle opener, and bottled water onboard for your convenience.

services.name: Wine Tour
services.desc: A Perfect Pairing - A Boat Tour to a Winery that is only accessible by water! Duration 3 Hours About This boat tour will start with a relaxing boat ride that lends itself to photo opportunities and ease of conversation with friends. As we head to Grindstone Island, we will make our way past quintessential river cottages, stately pines, and rocky cliffs. Before you disembark the boat on Grindstone Island, you may want to pause and capture some photos of the stunning views of the 1000 Island National Park.
